purpose: Local smoke benchmark for staged inference; not an accuracy claim.

fixture.source: Existing local image fixture; images are not included in this repository.

inference.note: The comparison runs every enabled model on every legacy full/leaf/center/tile view. Timings exclude the first cold model-session construction.

screening_results.note: The fixture overlaps the models' source domain and is only a smoke set. Top-1 agreement is not sufficient for field-use validation; all healthy candidates are reported as uncertain.
